name: chain41_analytic
purpose: TASKS 74's analytic re-read of chain 41 (claim 1 of TASKS 140): after the sixty test molecules' analytic labels are fetched into corpus/molecules, chain 41's fifteen saved models evaluated again on the same test lists and probes/chain41_read.py --analytic (the registered q5 lines; any set not wholly on analytic labels is refused; no retraining)

memory.basis: upper bound: chain 41's trainer peak (7.7 GB at n = 978, 19 Oct 2026); an eval loads the same corpus without training

estimate.basis: chain 41's own evals of these fifteen models: 133-275 s each (records' 'seconds'), ≈ 40 min together; the read is seconds
